discovery_notes: Follow-up 6 of B028 (DLR LE 2016). 30 standard WebSearch calls, blocked domains passed. New: Disney Duets Cruella/Pongo (MyPinCentral, on hold). Poinsettia Viva Navidad hold released (DPB exact-phrase). Resellers (ecrater, yourwdwstore, collectrandom, distradingpins4u) and pixiepin ignored. Most leads exhausted.
